rows.role_title: Председатель Правительства — Chairman of the Government
rows.text: Putin presented Dmitry Medvedev's candidacy to the State Duma for consent to his appointment as Chairman of the Government; the item reports that the deputies supported the candidacy by 299 votes to 144, with 443 deputies voting.
rows.locator: Lead paragraphs (8 May 2012, 16:00) and the start of Putin's address
